groups.focus: S01 RFC 4033 §§2-8: roles, trust, scope, last hop and temporal considerations.
S02 RFC 9364: DNSSEC BCP and document map, supplemented by newer updates.
S03 RFC 6840 §§5-6: validation, flags, usable algorithms/signatures and clarifications.
S04 RFC 9499 §§3-11: current terminology, actors, registration, states.
S05 RFC 4034 §§2-6 and Appendix B: DNSKEY/RRSIG/NSEC/DS, canonical form and key tags.
S06 RFC 4035 §§2-5: publication, response construction, resolution and validation.
S07 RFC 5155 §§3-9, 12: NSEC3/NSEC3PARAM, proof construction/validation and Opt-Out.
S08 RFC 9276 §3: modern NSEC3 operational settings and handling.
S09 RFC 2308, RFC 8020 §2: negative caching and NXDOMAIN cuts, read with later updates.
S10 RFC 8198 §§4-5; RFC 9077 §3: aggressive validated proof reuse and TTL updates.
S11 RFC 9824 §§2-9: compact denial, NXNAME, CO, response restoration and limits.
S12 RFC 8914 §§2-4; RFC 9520 §3; RFC 7646: EDE, resolution failure caching and negative trust anchors.
S13 RFC 6781 §§3-4; RFC 7583: signing operations, key/algorithm rollover and timing. The latter is Informational, not a universal fixed timer.
S14 RFC 5011 §§2-4; RFC 9718 (obsoletes RFC 7958): managed trust anchors and current root trust-anchor publication context.
S15 RFC 8901 §§2-7: multi-signer models, rollover and coordination.
S16 RFC 9904; IANA DNS Security Algorithm Numbers; IANA DS Digest Algorithms: current separated policy columns.
S17 RFC 6605; RFC 8080; RFC 4509: ECDSA, Edwards curves and SHA-256 DS encoding/examples.
S18 RFC 9905 §§2, 4-5; RFC 9906: contemporary algorithm deprecations and their precise scope.
S19 RFC 7344 §§3-6; RFC 8078 §§3-6: CDS/CDNSKEY management, initial-enrollment policy and removal signaling.
S20 RFC 9615 §§3-4; RFC 10026 §§3-7: authenticated bootstrap, operational checks, reporting and concurrent changes.
S21 RFC 9975 §3 and Appendix A; RFC 7477: child-signal consistency and separate CSYNC behavior.
S22 RFC 1034; RFC 1035; RFC 6891; RFC 7766: DNS messages, EDNS and TCP.
S23 RFC 5625 §§3-4; RFC 3225 §3: forwarding/proxy transparency and DO, read with RFC 6840.
S24 RFC 7858; RFC 8310: DNS over TLS and resolver authentication profiles.
S25 RFC 8945; RFC 5936; RFC 1995; RFC 1996; RFC 2136; RFC 3007; RFC 8976: TSIG, AXFR/IXFR, NOTIFY, UPDATE authentication/authorization and ZONEMD.
S26 RFC 6672 §§3-5; RFC 4592: DNAME and wildcard semantics.
S27 RFC 8749: DLV Historic. RFC Editor DNSSEC index: update discovery, not a replacement for the documents.
S28 RFC 4034 errata; RFC 4035 errata: verify individual status and applicable corrections.
S29 RFC 9859 §§2-4: DSYNC discovery and generalized NOTIFY; an additional trigger for existing checked workflows.
